newsitem.title: USA: Premark votes new shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Premark votes new shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Premark International Inc said on Wednesday that it adopted a new share purchase rights plan designed to assure equal treatment of all shareholders in the event of any proposed takeover attempt.
"The rights are not being distributed in response to any effort to acquire the company," said chief executive officer James Ringler in a statement.
The plan involves distribution of one purchase right for a new series of junior preferred stock for each outstanding share of the company's common stock.

The company will redeem common share purchase rights declared under a 10-year rights agreement adopted in March 1989. A payment of $0.00147 per share of Premark International common stock will be distributed to holders of record as of December 16, 1996.
The distribution is expected to occur with Premark's quarterly dividend payment on January 6, 1997.
The new rights will become effective on December 16, 1996 and expire on November 6, 2006.
"The new rights plan is designed to strengthen previous provisions aimed at fair and equal treatment for all shareholders in the event of any proposed takeover of the company," said Ringler.

As a response to unwelcome takeover tactics, the rights plan allows holders of rights to buy shares in either Premark or an acquiror at discounts from market value, or permits Premark to exchange common stock for the rights.
Premark markets products under such brand names as Wilsonart, Hobart, West Bend and Florida Tile.
